abstract: PURPOSE: To assess the surgical and oncological outcomes of laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) after chemotherapy. METHODS: Twenty patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell tumor underwent extraperitoneal laparoscopic RPLND after chemotherapy. The procedure was not indicated for patients with a pre-chemotherapy mass larger than 5 cm. Morbidity and oncological outcome were reviewed retrospectively. Surgical complications were graded according to the Clavien classification system. RESULTS: Laparoscopic RPLND was completed in all patients, and there was no conversion to open surgery. The median operating time was 223 min (range, 137-399 min). The median blood loss was 20 ml (range, 10-520 ml). There were no intraoperative complications. Postoperatively, 4 patients (20 %) had prolonged lymphorrhea (grade I) and 9 (45 %) had chyle leakage (grade I). Histological examination of the residual mass revealed necrosis in 16 (80 %) and the presence of teratoma with/without viable tumor in 4 (20 %). With a median follow-up of 45 months (range, 24-112), no patient has had disease recurrence. Normal antegrade ejaculation was preserved in all of the 14 patients studied. CONCLUSIONS: Extraperitoneal laparoscopic RPLND can be performed with acceptable morbidity and excellent cancer control in select patients. Surgeons should be aware of relatively high incidence of chyle leakage following this procedure.
abstract_ja: 目的：化学療法後の腹膜外腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の外科的および腫瘍学的成績を評価すること。方法：転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者20例が、化学療法後に腹膜外腹腔鏡下RPLNDを受けた。化学療法前に5cmを超える腫瘤があった患者は適応外とした。術後の成績と腫瘍学的転帰を後方視的に検討した。外科的合併症はClavien分類で評価した。結果：全例で腹腔鏡下RPLNDを完遂し、開腹移行は1例もなかった。手術時間中央値は223分(137～399分)、出血量中央値は20ml(10～520ml)であった。術中合併症は認めなかった。術後、4例(20%)に遷延性リンパ漏(グレードI)、9例(45%)に乳糜漏(グレードI)を認めた。残存腫瘤の病理検査では、16例(80%)で壊死、4例(20%)で奇形腫の存在(生存腫瘍の有無を問わず)を認めた。追跡期間中央値は45か月(24～112か月)で、再発を認めた患者はいない。検討した14例全例で正常な順行性射精が温存された。結論：選択された患者では、腹膜外腹腔鏡下RPLNDは許容される合併症率と良好ながん制御をもって施行可能である。本術式後の乳糜漏の発生率が比較的高いことに、術者は留意すべきである。
